proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
proposed_widenings.justification: Activated magic items can have a range distinct from self. The Rod of Rulership targets creatures within 120 feet, but ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field. The tracer renders the target attachment as 'range Self', silently misrepresenting the 120-foot range.
proposed_widenings.evidence: each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself

notes: Core mechanic encodes cleanly: Magic-action save_gate → apply_condition charmed, once per dawn. Two omissions: (1) the 120-foot range is missing from ActivatedAbilityMechanics (surface_widening); (2) 'commanded to something contrary to its nature' as an early-end trigger is DM agenda with no atom equivalent, legitimately omitted. The timed 8-hour duration with target_damaged_by_caster_or_ally early-end typechecks correctly but the tracer does not emit lifecycle persist/expire nodes for ActivatedAbilityMechanics durations (unlike TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics which does trace them).
